summary.text: Susan K. McComas, a Republican, represents District 34B (Harford County) in the Maryland House of Delegates and is listed on the Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: McComas was born in Denver, Colorado, on April 3, 1951, and graduated from Cheyenne Central High School in 1969.
The legislature's biography lists a B.A. in social and behavioral sciences from The Johns Hopkins University in 1974 and a J.D. from the University of Wyoming College of Law in 1980.

It lists a series of early legal positions in Wyoming, service as a commissioner of the District Court of Harford County from 1983 to 1985, and work as a sole practitioner from 1985, and says McComas is married.

sources.title: Delegate Susan K. McComas (Maryland General Assembly)
